issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode flipped from EXTERNAL to FIXED is a silent contract change for existing callers.
issues.detail: Every caller using InputParams() defaults now gets different endpointing behavior (VAD emission, finalization triggers) with no deprecation path. This is an API change mislabeled as a fix. Add a changelog entry under .changed.md, document the migration, and consider a transitional warning when the default is taken.

issues.description: process_frame finalization now keyed on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame narrows the supertype contract.
issues.detail: The base STTService contract finalizes on UserStoppedSpeakingFrame; this subtype only finalizes on VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, with a warn-and-do-nothing branch when internal VAD is enabled. Either accept both frame types, document the stricter precondition at the supertype, or subscribe to the frame only when not _enable_vad and drop the conditional.

issues.description: _enable_vad invariant spans TurnDetectionMode and EndOfUtteranceMode without a stated specification.
issues.detail: Membership is tested against a list literal including EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED, coupling two enums whose 'FIXED/EXTERNAL disables internal VAD' invariant lives only in the literal. Write the invariant at the class boundary, use a module-level frozenset or tuple for the fixed membership test, and ensure the imported symbol exists.

issues.description: split_sentences is declared Optional[bool] but coerced via `or False`, collapsing tri-state semantics.
issues.detail: Declaring `bool | None = None` then writing `params.split_sentences or False` defeats the optional and forces a coercion at the use site. Either declare it `bool = False` and pass through, or define None as 'use vendor default' and only set speech_segment_config when the caller opted in.

issues.description: speech_segment_config is unconditionally overwritten, discarding generic-loop and vendor defaults.
issues.detail: After the preceding loop, config.speech_segment_config is replaced wholesale with SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=...). If upstream VoiceAgentConfig has a meaningful default or SpeechSegmentConfig grows fields, callers silently lose them. Set only when the caller opted in, or construct once with all known fields and document the frame.

issues.description: Commented-out start_processing_metrics call was moved rather than resolved.
issues.detail: Relocating `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` from after to before the broadcast changes nothing executable and signals indecision. Either uncomment it with an ordering rationale or delete it; git remembers if it's needed later.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a small SDK-wiring patch with two quietly load-bearing contract changes: the default turn_detection_mode flip from EXTERNAL to FIXED, and the narrowing of process_frame finalization to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame. Both alter observable behavior for existing callers without a deprecation path and deserve a .changed.md entry plus documented contracts. The _enable_vad invariant now spans two enums and should be stated explicitly at the module boundary. Secondary cleanups: drop the Optional[bool]/`or False` dance on split_sentences, stop clobbering vendor defaults in speech_segment_config, and resolve the migrated commented-out metrics call.
